_readme: One entry per course page. fee and duration are null on purpose: fees are not decided and durations are confirmed at enrolment. Do not invent them. Tool names may change over time, so teach current free versions where available.

courses.title: Certificate in Computer Application
courses.subtitle: Computer basics
courses.seoTitle: Computer Training in Onitsha | OCATECH Digital Solutions
courses.metaDescription: Learn Windows, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email and the internet from zero at OCATECH, 62 New Market Road, Onitsha. Certificate included. Apply today.
courses.summary: Learn to use a computer with confidence: Windows, typing, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email and the internet, step by step from zero.
courses.whoFor: Complete beginners, school leavers, job seekers, traders, and anyone who wants to stop depending on other people for computer tasks.
outcomes: Manage files, folders and settings on Windows
Write, format and print professional documents in Word
Build simple spreadsheets with formulas and charts in Excel
Create clear slide presentations in PowerPoint
Use email, search engines and cloud storage safely
Fix common everyday computer problems
courses.finalProject: Prepare a CV, a price-list spreadsheet and a short presentation for a small business.
courses.prerequisites: None. You do not need any computer experience.

Draft emails, proposals, product descriptions and posts in minutes

Create images, designs and presentations with AI-assisted tools
Check AI answers for mistakes and protect private information
courses.finalProject: Set up an AI-assisted workflow for a real or sample small business.
courses.prerequisites: Basic use of a phone or computer. The Certificate in Computer Application helps but is not required.

courses.title: Data Analysis

courses.title: Cybersecurity
courses.subtitle: Defence and ethical hacking
courses.metaDescription: Learn to protect devices and networks and understand ethical hacking in a safe lab. Cybersecurity course in Onitsha, in person.
courses.summary: Learn how attacks happen and how to defend people, devices and networks, in a safe practice lab.
courses.whoFor: IT students, support staff, business owners and anyone who wants to start a security career or protect their own business.
outcomes: Protect accounts, devices and data with good security habits
Recognise phishing, scams and malware
Understand networks, ports and common vulnerabilities
Use ethical hacking tools in an isolated lab
Secure Wi-Fi, routers and basic servers
Follow the legal and ethical rules of security work
courses.finalProject: Run a security assessment of a practice network and write a report.
courses.prerequisites: Basic computer skills. Networking knowledge helps; the Hardware Maintenance & Wi-Fi Networking course is a good starting point.
courses.note: Hacking skills are taught for defence and are used only on systems you own or have written permission to test.

courses.title: Hardware Maintenance & Wi-Fi Networking
courses.subtitle: Repair computers and set up networks
courses.seoTitle: Computer Hardware & Wi-Fi Training in Onitsha | OCATECH
courses.metaDescription: Learn computer repair, Windows installation, router and Wi-Fi setup and network troubleshooting. Hands-on training at our Onitsha center.
courses.summary: Open up a computer, find what is wrong and fix it, then set up reliable Wi-Fi and wired networks.
courses.whoFor: Beginners, technicians, shop owners and anyone who wants to start a computer repair or networking business.
outcomes: Identify and replace computer parts
Install Windows, drivers and essential software
Diagnose slow, overheating and non-starting computers
Back up and protect customer data during repairs
Set up routers, access points and secure Wi-Fi
Make and test network cables and troubleshoot connections
courses.finalProject: Repair and restore a faulty computer and set up a small office network.

courses.title: CCNA Networking
courses.subtitle: Routing, switching and network administration
courses.seoTitle: CCNA Networking Training in Onitsha | OCATECH
courses.metaDescription: Prepare for the Cisco CCNA exam with hands-on routing, switching and subnetting practice. Networking training in Onitsha.
courses.summary: Learn how business networks work (IP addressing, switching, routing and security) and prepare for the Cisco CCNA certification exam.
courses.whoFor: IT students, technicians and anyone aiming for a network administrator role.
outcomes: Plan IP addresses and subnets
Configure switches, VLANs and routers
Understand routing, NAT and basic network services
Set up and secure wireless networks
Apply basic network security controls
Troubleshoot network faults step by step
courses.finalProject: Design, configure and troubleshoot a multi-office network in Packet Tracer.
courses.prerequisites: Basic networking knowledge. The Hardware Maintenance & Wi-Fi Networking course is the recommended starting point.
courses.note: The CCNA exam is booked and paid for separately with Cisco’s exam provider. We prepare you for it and do not guarantee a pass.
